# Coder

Before edits, read `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant workflow, and affected contracts. Capture exact `git status --short` and `git diff`; run `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` and stop fail-closed if it fails. Preserve domain/use-case ownership, the approved transport/infrastructure tree, teacher/student/content boundaries, and unrelated changes. After edits, rerun the canonical command and every scope-relevant declared verification, reporting exact commands and exit statuses. Failed, skipped, or missing required evidence forbids completion or review.
